@@ -7,6 +7,53 @@ class Booknotes(db.CommonExtras):
     PRIMARY_KEY = ["username", "work_id", "edition_id"]
     NULL_EDITION_VALUE = -1
 
+    @classmethod
+    def update_work_id(cls, current_work_id, new_work_id, _test=False):
+        """Update a work ID without losing notes when the target exists.
+
+        A collision in booknotes means the requested update cannot be applied
+        safely: even notes for different editions must be retained. Report the
+        collision as a failed delete for compatibility with the admin summary.
+        """
+        oldb = db.get_db()
+        target_exists = list(oldb.select(
+            cls.TABLENAME,
+            where="work_id=$work_id",
+            vars={"work_id": new_work_id},
+            limit=1,
+        ))
+        if target_exists:
+            source_exists = list(oldb.select(
+                cls.TABLENAME,
+                where="work_id=$work_id",
+                vars={"work_id": current_work_id},
+                limit=1,
+            ))
+            return {
+                "rows_changed": 0,
+                "rows_deleted": 0,
+                "failed_deletes": 1 if source_exists else 0,
+            }
+
+        transaction = oldb.transaction()
+        try:
+            rows_changed = oldb.update(
+                cls.TABLENAME,
+                where="work_id=$work_id",
+                work_id=new_work_id,
+                vars={"work_id": current_work_id},
+            )
+        except (db.UniqueViolation, db.IntegrityError):
+            transaction.rollback()
+            return {"rows_changed": 0, "rows_deleted": 0, "failed_deletes": 1}
+
+        transaction.rollback() if _test else transaction.commit()
+        return {
+            "rows_changed": rows_changed,
+            "rows_deleted": 0,
+            "failed_deletes": 0,
+        }
+
